jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(6)(H) inventory: Rivendell Interstate Supervisory District -- the Rivendell Interstate School District, an interstate district under the NH-VT compact (16 V.S.A. sections 771-782) and its own supervisory district (member towns: Fairlee, Vershire, West Fairlee VT; Orford NH). Operates PK-12. Only the Vermont-side seats are modeled (Walter's ruling; the Dresden precedent).

sources.note: Rivendell ISD board agenda packet, April 7, 2026 (official HighBond portal, doc 7055): the February 2026 minutes' town-labeled rosters name the full 11-member board (Fairlee 3, Orford NH 3, Vershire 2, West Fairlee 2, At-Large 1); the certified 2025 tally (minutes signed by District Clerk Brenda Gray) elects Ludwig (Fairlee, 3-yr) and Zwikelmaier (West Fairlee, 3-yr) and Gahagan (At-Large, 1-yr, 174 votes); the certified 2026 tally elects Bouquillon (Fairlee, 57), Osgood (Vershire, 20) and Gahagan re-elected (At-Large, 117). Per Walter's ruling for interstate districts, only the Vermont-side seats are built -- the Orford (NH) seats are OUT. The 2026 filing notice (Town of Fairlee) lists the Fairlee seat expiring 2026 as held by Jennifer Hallmartel "(Appointed)" -- she sat through Feb. 17, 2026 and Bouquillon was elected to the seat; her appointment date and predecessor are undocumented, so she is NOT minted. Powers/Thames/Cadwell ends are unpublished in fetched sources (the certified April 13, 2024 minutes that would fix them at 2027 sit behind a BoardDocs 403) -- minted with no ends off the current minutes.

board.post_note: MODEL (VT side): per-town posts for Fairlee (3), Vershire (2) and West Fairlee (2) -- town-only electorates under the compact -- plus one district-wide At-Large post (1 seat, 1-year terms, voted by all four towns incl. Orford). The board's full size is 11 (incl. Orford's 3 NH seats, not modeled).

directors.name: Clement Powers
directors.note: Sitting in the Feb./March 2026 minutes; his seat was not on the 2025/2026 ballots. No end published in a fetched source.

directors.name: Edward A. Bouquillon
directors.note: Elected March 21, 2026 (certified tally: 57 votes), 3-year term, to the seat Jennifer Hallmartel had held by appointment.

directors.name: Nate Thames
directors.note: Sitting in the Feb./March 2026 minutes. No end published in a fetched source.

directors.name: George A. Osgood
directors.note: Elected March 21, 2026 (certified tally: 20 votes), 3-year term, to the seat whose term Kathy Hooke held to 2026.

directors.name: Rebekah Cadwell
directors.note: Same person as the West Fairlee library trustee record. No end published in a fetched source.

directors.name: Sarah Zwikelmaier
directors.note: Elected March 15, 2025 (certified tally: 23 votes), 3-year term. Spelling is the district's own; news prints "Zwickelmaier."

directors.name: Lillian G. Gahagan
directors.note: At-Large director (Fairlee resident); elected March 15, 2025 and re-elected March 21, 2026 (certified tally: 117 votes), 1-year terms. Styled Lillian "Gay-C" Gahagan in the minutes.

directors.name: Kathy Hooke
directors.note: Held the Vershire seat to 2026 per the district's official 2026 filing notice ("Term expiring: Kathy Hooke" -- unlike Hallmartel's Fairlee seat, not marked appointed); George A. Osgood was elected to the seat March 21, 2026. Recorded as a departed elected membership on the filing notice + certified tally.
